tools.description: Android ETC1 texture compression tool for OpenGL ES optimization
tools.usage: etc1tool input.png --encodeNoHeader # Encode to ETC1 format\netc1tool input.pkm --decode # Decode ETC1 texture\netc1tool --help # Show compression options

tools.description: Android HPROF heap dump converter for memory analysis tools
tools.usage: hprof-conv input.hprof output.hprof # Convert Android HPROF to standard format\nadb shell am dumpheap com.app /sdcard/heap.hprof && adb pull /sdcard/heap.hprof . && hprof-conv heap.hprof converted.hprof
